verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Bounded execution and failure semantics are especially complete: scheduler fan-out, worker bound, isolated non-production SUT, ordered execution, full capture, infrastructure-only retry, behavior-failure continuation, and typed separation are all explicitly represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R17 is only partial because the board shows that the artifact-only grader receives no original request but does not explicitly state the resulting avoidance of anchoring.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents the complete orchestration path from immutable pinned inputs through bounded isolated execution, evidence-gated concurrent grading, compatible baseline comparison, promotion, and audit retention. All system-defining requirements are present; the only incomplete qualifier is the explicit anti-anchoring rationale for withholding the original request from the artifact-only grader.
